originalTitle: Foldable Flight: The Best Paper Airplanes
content:
Shop from our collection of paper airplane products, or enjoy folding the best paper airplanes in the world!

This World Record prototype can fly over 300 feet!!!

Unite holds the world record for time aloft at 31.2 seconds!

Tutorials for Arrowhead have been viewed over 100 million times!

Corsair is great for indoor and outdoor flying!

The SU-27 is based on the Russion fighter, and it flies brilliantly!

Cub is the prototype for the world record breaking design, CHEEtah!

Mystic is a modified version of the Nakamura Lock, by Eiji Nakamura.

Quick Blade is easy to fold and flies over 100 ft (30m)!

Designed by Michael LaFosse, F-14 Tomcat is truly iconic!

AeroDactyl is easy to fold and it flaps as it flies!

Jetstream is an asymmetrical paper airplane that still flies well!

Venom is an aggressive paper airplane that flies over 100 feet!

Double Take may look strange, but it still flies well.

Ballista is the fastest plane on the site. Launch it with all your might!

Ghost Bat flaps as it flies while also boasting a great glide ratio.

Concorde is based on the classic dart, but has a few extra steps.

Astral is fairly easy to fold and flies extremely far.

Emperion One is a great glider with and without the PowerUp motors!

X-01 Missile spirals as it flies and is ready to take down your next target!

Starshot looks awesome and flies incredibily far!

Sniper is easy to fold and is extremely accurate!

Elanus is one of the best gliders you will ever fold!

Silk Shark features a fin like those found on real sharks!

Vapor is one of the easiest planes on this website, and it flies really well!

F-102 Delta is a beautiful origami jet designed by Michael LaFosse.

Durandal is very difficult to fold, but it looks amazing and flies well too!

Strider uses a complex folding sequence to create its awesome fins.

Asteroid uses clever origami to fold into its unique shape.

Katana features a fully-rounded engine and cool tail fins!

Zenith is an amazing glider that can fly over 100 ft (30m)!

Bomber looks amazing and glides beautifully.

Ranseur takes the classic dart to another level!

F-21 TigerShrike uses clever folding and cutting to arrive at its shape.

A-3 Afterburner uses brilliant origami to create a rounded engine at its rear.

Dagger is very fast and it flies very, very far!

X-15 RedTail features a unique shape with its rocket-like engines.

Designed by Ian Zhou, Fork-Wing is a Grand Prize Winner of our contest!

Spinner does exactly what it's name suggests — it spirals as it flies!

SU-57 is somewhere between Easy and Intermediate in difficulty.

Plasma X is an incredible distance plane that can fly over 150 ft (50m)!

Space Chaser is unlike any paper airplane you've folded!

Eclipse is an origami masterpiece, but it's very difficult to fold!

Alpha Lock is easy to fold and it can fly extremely far!

Throw Brigand high into the air and watch it fly a great distance!

Stratus features a unique folding sequence and flies up to 80 feet!

Firestrike features a unique folding sequence to create its awesome fins!

Pegasus is a wild-looking paper airplane with a huge horn!

Alkonost is hard to fold, but it can fly over 160 feet!

Rival 3 is an amazing glider that can fly over 150 feet!

Sparrow is a bird-like glider that flies well!

Rubicon isn't that hard to fold and can fly very far!

Designed by Jared Ong Hong Hao, The Swifter is a great boomerang!

Viper can fly well on its own, or with the PowerUp motors!

Lancer is very hard to fold, but it flies over 150 feet!

Trifecta locks in its 3D shape and can fly over 100 feet (30m)!

Designed by Jago P., The Sienna is an exceptional glider that flies far!

Mighty Eagle is a competition winning glider, designed by Zayan.

Phenom is a lightning-fast jet, designed by Kyle Boyer!

Artemis, designed by Paper Base, features cool fins and flies well!

Looper is an excellent stunt plane that boomerangs back to you!

X-2 Yanagi features a jet fold and a really interesting shape!

Scorcher takes inspiration from the classic dart, but it flies much farther!

Flare is relatively easy to fold and flies nicely!

Guardian is an excellent dart that flies really far!

This plane is a great boomerang, designed by Aiden Dominguez.

The Walloping Cebu is designed by Carson Acosta.

Ember is a hybrid that boasts an incredible glide ratio.

Throw Havoc as hard as you can and watch it disappear into the distance!

Aethon offers a nice balance of speed and gliding ability.

Q-1 Gannet is a truly unique plane with its drone-like appearance.

Use clever folding and cutting to make Q-2 Griffon, by Evan Brus.

Quill is an exceptional dart, capable of flying over 180 feet!

Valkyrie, by Nicholas Cheng, is capable of flying very far!

Leo Liang's Palladium is the best airtime glider on this website!

Ripper looks amazing and flies well too!

Orion is a Grand Prize Winner of the 2025 Paper Airplane Contest!

Wolverine, by Jude, features threatening blades and still flies well!

Designed by Jared Ong Hong Hao, this is a modified version of The Swifter.

Shrike is designed by Kaan Y. and can fly over 100 feet!

Halo features a clever lock and flies very, very well!

Lingluo, designed by Zhang Renjie, is an excellent glider!

Insurgent looks amazing and flies well too!

Sky Piercer is an exceptional dart that can fly up to 150 feet!

Neal Rawat's Challenger Alpha is an epic jet that flies well!

Crossbow is inspired by Arrowhead and flies even farther!

Designed by Turbulent, Lapetus is an extremely fast dart!

Gremlin is relatively easy to fold and flies quite well.

F-11d BlackWing is Evan Brus's best known design!

Diamond Head can be folded as a traditional glider or as a boomerang.

Designed by Ezra Craig, Spike looks amazing and flies well too!

Quickdraw locks together in its 3-dimensional shape.

Elexi is designed by jet-specialist Aleks Karlsen!

Designed by Aiden Dominguez, Viper flies 100 feet!

Invictus locks together in a 3-dimensional shape and flies well.
